title: Phylogenetic Tree and Ancestral Sequence Reconstruction
author: Matthew Kellom
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6qrhdv6

steps.title: Collect Target Homolog Sequences
steps.instruction: Obtain a set of known or trusted target amino acid sequences, such as from UniProt.

steps.title: Search Metagenome for Target Hits
steps.instruction: Search for target hits within metagenome sequences using DIAMOND (or blastx for smaller datasets) with a recommended e-value cutoff of at least 1e-20.

steps.title: Translate Protein-Coding Hits
steps.instruction: Translate the protein-coding target hits into amino acid sequences using TranslatorX.

steps.title: Annotate Hits
steps.instruction: Annotate the hits against a local copy of the NCBI nr database using DIAMOND or BLAST.

steps.title: Select Sequences of Interest
steps.instruction: Choose the taxa of interest and select sequences of appropriate length for the protein from the metagenome hits.

steps.title: Align Sequences
steps.instruction: Align the collected sequences and closely related complete outgroup sequence(s) using MAFFT.

steps.title: Construct Phylogenetic Tree
steps.instruction: Generate a tree using RAxML and inspect the results for accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Consult the alignment if any node appears out of place to determine if it should remain in the dataset

steps.title: Verify Substitution Model and Support
steps.instruction: Check the RAxML amino acid substitution model and branch support using IQTree.

steps.title: Perform Branch Support Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze branch support with MR Bayes, requiring the creation of a nexus and mbatch file.

substeps.instruction: Set mbatch settings: lset nst=6 rates invgamma; prset aamodelpr=fixed(lg); (ensure model matches RAxML and IQTree selections)
Set MCMC parameters: mcmcp ngen=1000000 nruns=2 nchains=4 samplefreq=100 printfreq=10000 relburnin=yes burninfrac=0.25; mcmc; sumt; sump;

steps.title: Perform Ancestral Sequence Reconstruction
steps.instruction: Submit the MAFFT alignment and RAxML best_tree to the FastML web portal (http://fastml.tau.ac.il/) or a local version.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Amino Acids' and the correct model from the tree building process

steps.title: Extract and Visualize Results
steps.instruction: Obtain the 25 most probable ancestral sequences at the nodes of interest from the FastML results page.

substeps.instruction: Visualize the tree results using FigTree
